newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac sees lira ERM talks entry ended by end-96.
newsitem.headline: Chirac sees lira ERM talks entry ended by end-96.

text.p: President Jacques Chirac said on Tuesday he expected that negotiations on the entry of the lira into the European exchange rate mechanism would be completed by year-end.
Chirac told a news conference that talks on the lira joining the ERM were under way.

"(Italy) has asked to enter and of course we are all happy about that...the negotiations on the re-entry of the lira are underway and will of course be completed by the end of the year as is required," he said.
Italy, however, has not yet made a formal demand to bring the lira back into the ERM which it left in 1992 after a currency crisis, an official source said.
Italy has said it wants to bring the lira back into the ERM, but until it makes an official demand formal negotiations cannot start.
Italy, like Spain, has said it wants to be among the founders of the single currency and Chirac said he hoped it could make it.
"Italy has expressed the same desire and we take note of this will, express our happiness, and hope that Italy will be ready at the same time as the others for the launch."
